title: Extension of g ↦ ∫_{E∩U} div g to a locally bounded linear functional on continuous compactly supported fields in U
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open and E ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable with locally finite perimeter in U (SimonGMT IsLocallyBV U χ_E). Call g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N admissible if g is continuous, has compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U. Then there is a function Λ : (ℝ^N → ℝ^N) → ℝ such that (a) Λ(g + h) = Λ(g) + Λ(h) for all admissible g, h; (b) Λ(c g) = c Λ(g) for all c ∈ ℝ and admissible g; (c) for every compact K ⊆ U there is C ∈ ℝ with Λ(g) ≤ C for every continuous g with tsupport g ⊆ K and |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x; (d) Λ(g) = ∫_{E∩U} div g dL^N for every C¹ g with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → HasLocallyFinitePerimeter U E → ∃ Λ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ, (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ (g + h) = Λ g + Λ h) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (c • g) = c * Λ g) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → Λ g ≤ C) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ g = ∫ x in E ∩ U, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x
